headline: Dream beat the Valkyries 79-65 and tie the Finals 1-1
whyCareReason: Atlanta took Game 2 at Chase Center. The series is tied. Game 3 is Wednesday in Atlanta, with no score posted.
teaser: Angel Reese 30 points and 16 rebounds. Golden State scored 9 points in the third quarter.
story: The Atlanta Dream beat the Golden State Valkyries 79-65 in Game 2 at Chase Center. Quarters: Dream 18, 21, 21, 19 and Valkyries 21, 16, 9, 19. The official scorer's report and ESPN agree. Angel Reese had 30 points and 16 rebounds on 10 of 16 from the field and 9 of 11 at the line. Allisha Gray scored 18. Jordin Canada had 13 points and 10 assists. Gabby Williams scored 14 for Golden State. Attendance was 18,064, a sellout. The series is tied 1-1. Game 3 is Wednesday, 21 October, at 8:00 p.m. ET at State Farm Arena on USA, Peacock and CNBC. No Game 3 score is posted.
stakes: The series returns to Atlanta level. A Wednesday win would put that club up 2-1.
rivalryAngle: Atlanta's first Finals win leveled a series Golden State had led after a 68-64 Game 1.
funFacts: Reese 30 points, 16 rebounds. Gray 18. Canada 13 points and 10 assists. Williams 14.
Game 3: Wednesday 21 October, 8:00 p.m. ET, State Farm Arena. Series tied 1-1. No score.
